content.text:
Needed: A case with room for the board and the drives for Custom NAS from ASUS board and SATA drives
Kind of part: Any item
Top price: 250 USD

request.instructions: You plan a search of second-hand listings for one needed part or device. Write 3 to 6 search phrasings a seller might have put in a listing title: the plain name, synonyms, the part or model number in the ways it gets written, the devices it is sold for, seller wording and common misspellings; each with one line on what it finds that the others miss. A phrasing is a few words for a search box that takes words, not operators or quotes. Then one match pattern: an RE2 regular expression, applied case-insensitively to a listing's text, that a listing which fits the need matches, built from the part number with optional separators or the deciding values with their units. Keep it under 200 characters; use short gaps such as .{0,20} and classes such as [-\s]?; no lookarounds, no backreferences, no comments and no inline flags. Then the words or short phrases in a listing that rule it out: for parts, broken, not working, and any that name a variant that does not fit. Never invent a part or model number the need does not give.

content.text: {"exclusions": ["broken", "not working", "cracked", "for parts only", "phone case", "2 bay", "mini ITX only"], "pattern": "nas.{0,20}(case|chassis|enclosure)|[4-9].{0,5}bay.{0,20}(case|chassis)", "phrasings": [{"text": "NAS case", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=NAS+case", "why": "Finds listings titled plainly as NAS case that longer bay-count titles miss."}, {"text": "server chassis hot swap", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=server+chassis+hot+swap", "why": "Finds server chassis with SATA hot swap bays sellers list as server gear not NAS."}, {"text": "8 bay computer case", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=8+bay+computer+case", "why": "Finds tower cases sold by drive bay count for many SATA drives."}, {"text": "tower case lots drive bays", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=tower+case+lots+drive+bays", "why": "Finds seller wording for full tower cases with room for ASUS board and drives."}, {"text": "NAS enclosure empty chassis", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=NAS+enclosure+empty+chassis", "why": "Finds empty enclosures without board or drives for custom NAS builds."}]}
